scripts.local:up: mkdir -p apps/api/data && MINIDOG_INGEST_ENDPOINT=http://api:4000 docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yaml --profile app up -d --build --wait
scripts.local:down: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yaml --profile app rm --stop --force api web && docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yaml up -d --wait otel-collector
scripts.local:logs: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yaml --profile app logs -f api web
